segments.text: Lie down or sit with support. Close your eyes if that feels safe.
Notice your feet. Toes, arches, heels. No need to change anything.
Move attention up the legs. Calves, knees, thighs.
Belly and chest. Feel breath move without forcing it.
Hands, arms, shoulders. Let them be heavy.
Jaw, eyes, forehead. Soften the whole head.
Feel the body as one field of sensation. Rest here.
Slowly wiggle fingers and toes. Open your eyes when ready.
